name: cso-solar-monorepo
description: CSO Solar — Unified Monorepo with Design System

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/design-system && npm run build --workspace=dashboard && npm run build --workspace=warehouse && npm run build --workspace=proposals-v2 && npm run build --workspace=projects && npm run build --workspace=green-tariff-v2 && npm run build --workspace=land-lease && node -e "fs.cpSync('public/green-tariff', 'public/files', {recursive: true})"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:warehouse" "npm run dev:proposals-v2" "npm run dev:projects"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules warehouse/node_modules projects/node_modules proposals-v2/node_modules
